item.title: Parent-Led & Disability-Inclusive: Delhi Amends RTE Rules to Modify School Management Committees Structure
item.description: Delhi Govt has notified Delhi Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Amendment Rules mandating 75% parent membership in School Management Committee also including parents of children with disabilities. The post Parent-Led & Disability-Inclusive: Delhi Amends RTE Rules to Modify School Management Committees Structure appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Keeping penis on vagina without penetration not rape, but attempt to rape: Chhattisgarh HC reduces sentence of rape convict in 2005 case
item.description: “The sine qua non of the offence of rape is penetration, and not ejaculation. Ejaculation without penetration constitutes an attempt to commit rape and not actual rape.” The post Keeping penis on vagina without penetration not rape, but attempt to rape: Chhattisgarh HC reduces sentence of rape convict in 2005 case appeared first on SCC Times.

item.description: “The question of law is kept open to be decided in an appropriate case.” The post Supreme Court dismisses Centre’s plea on Retrospective Honorarium to Law Researchers appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Rajasthan High Court grants bail to accused allegedly involved in gambling activities of Rs. 13 lakhs
item.description: The accused had allegedly contravened Sections 318(4), 319(2), 336(3), 338, 340(2), 112(2) and 61(2)(a) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, Section 66D of the Information Technology Act, and Section 13 of the Rajasthan Public Gambling Ordinance, 1949. The post Rajasthan High Court grants bail to accused allegedly involved in gambling activities of Rs. 13 lakhs appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: CAM advised Kwality Wall’s (India) Ltd in relation to listing of its equity shares on BSE and NSE
item.description: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Kwality Wall’s (India) Limited on the listing of its equity shares on BSE and NSE following the demerger of Hindustan Unilever Limited’s ice cream business into KWIL under a scheme of arrangement. The firm also acted as sole transaction counsel to HUL on the demerger and listing. The post CAM advised Kwality Wall’s (India) Ltd in relation to listing of its equity shares on BSE and NSE appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Madras HC: Procedural irregularity in affidavit filing doesn’t justify abandonment of Modern Kitchens’ trade mark application by Registrar
item.description: “Procedural provisions should not be interpreted with rigidity to the extent of defeating the substantive rights vested in the parties.” The post Madras HC: Procedural irregularity in affidavit filing doesn’t justify abandonment of Modern Kitchens’ trade mark application by Registrar appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Pre-arrest bail not maintainable after arrest and release on transit bail; Accused can only seek regular bail: Kerala HC
item.description: “Under Section 482(1) BNSS, a pre-arrest bail is maintainable only by a person who has reason to believe that he might be arrested for having committed a non bailable offence. The provision safeguards individuals from the possibility of being arrested with malicious intent, and pre-arrest bail must be sought only before an arrest is made.” The post Pre-arrest bail not maintainable after arrest and release on transit bail; Accused can only seek regular bail: Kerala HC appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Sanction under S. 19 Prevention of Corruption Act not required after retirement of public servant: Bombay High Court
item.description: “The offences alleged to have been committed by the applicant under the IPC cannot be regarded as acts done or purported to be done in furtherance of his official duties.” The post Sanction under S. 19 Prevention of Corruption Act not required after retirement of public servant: Bombay High Court appeared first on SCC Times.
